flagged.evidence: The Statement says a Rayleigh-quotient step may be started from x(t) and 2.1 assigns a next slope at t=0. But 1.1 gives mu(0)=2 and A-mu(0)I=diag(0,-1), which is singular. The current def-rayleigh-quotient-iteration defines a step only “whenever A-mu_k I is invertible.” Thus no next iterate, and hence no next slope, exists at t=0.

Step 2.1 says “Applying [L3] to the unit vector x_k gives |mu_k-lambda|<=C_0 theta_k^2.” Its cited dependency prop-rayleigh-quotient-and-residual-converge-along-hermitian-power-iteration assumes a simple dominant eigenvalue and a sequence generated by power iteration from a start with nonzero dominant component. This theorem assumes only that lambda is simple and x_k is a Rayleigh-quotient iterate; it establishes neither dominance nor that x_k is a power iterate. The cited proposition therefore does not license step 2.1.

Step 5.1 says that after Sigma D Sigma=Sigma gives X=diag(sigma_i^{-1}), “Substituting that into D Sigma D=D yields Y=Z=W=0.” That implication is false without the self-adjoint conditions from 4.1: for Sigma=[1] and D=[[1,1],[0,0]], both Sigma D Sigma=Sigma and D Sigma D=D hold but Y is nonzero. Self-adjointness of Sigma D and D Sigma would immediately force Y=Z=0 and then W=0, but the step does not invoke it.

Let T_beta=[[0,1,0],[1,0,beta],[0,beta,1]] with beta>0 tending to zero. It is symmetric tridiagonal and tends to a deflated matrix. Its trailing block [[0,beta],[beta,1]] has the unique Wilkinson shift mu_beta=(1+sqrt(1+4 beta^2))/2, so it is never at a tie. A direct QR calculation for T_beta-mu_beta I gives the new bottom subdiagonal beta_+=beta/sqrt(2)+O(beta^3), rather than O(beta^3). Hence no fixed C can make |beta_+|<=C|beta|^3 in a neighbourhood of this deflated set. The statement needs an additional nonresonance/separation hypothesis; L1-L3 do not supply one.

The page says these iterations have “all of their hypotheses stated” and their conclusions occur only under conditions “that actually make those conclusions true.” The scoped RQI example nevertheless treats t=0 as a valid step although its shift makes A-mu I singular, and the scoped Wilkinson theorem is false on the non-tie family T_beta described above. Thus this page-level assurance asserts more than the current contents establish.
